decisions.reason: The formwork profile system lies close to the firm's core formwork knowledge, was presented on its own page through 2019, and benefits from the firm's in-house R&D, so management can interpret results and refine it.
The shuttering magnet block line extends the firm's established magnetic formwork expertise, so the firm can assimilate market feedback and improve the models rather than abandon them.
This magnetic formwork component builds directly on related knowledge and had a dedicated page in both years, which suggests it remains a deliberate part of the offer.

Although it was only mentioned on the website, the component sits within the firm's core formwork competence, and the firm's R&D capacity supports keeping and improving it, with somewhat higher risk of consolidation given the sibling magnetic strips line was already removed.
